candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to return 503, order POST /v1/orders to fail with transport ReadTimeout and 502, and gateway POST /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of the redis timeout (saturation, network, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503, order transport ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 on /v1/checkout, matching the alert. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis. Redis-side evidence is absent, so the timeout is bounded but its underlying cause is unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Redis server metrics (latency, connections, saturation) during the incident window
Inventory service logs/metrics for reserve_inventory failures
